mainEntity.name: How long does it take to switch to Prompt?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most clinics are fully up and running within a few days. We handle data migration, system configuration, and team onboarding, so you don’t have to.

mainEntity.name: Will there be downtime during the transition?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Clinics stay operational while we handle setup in the background. There’s no disruption to your patient flow or revenue cycle.

mainEntity.name: How hard is it to train my team on Prompt?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prompt is designed to be intuitive. We provide dedicated onboarding, video tutorials, and training sessions with your success manager to answer questions, build confidence, and get started with ease.

mainEntity.name: Is support really as good as people say?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our U.S.-based support team includes experts in billing, clinical workflows, and EDI. We don’t offshore or route you to bots. You’ll talk to real people who understand your clinic.

mainEntity.name: Can I speak with someone before I switch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Schedule a demo or ask for a real customer reference who was previously on Systems4PT. We’re happy to connect you.
Prompt offers transparent, flat-rate pricing. No hidden fees for features like reminders, digital intake, or HEP. What you see is what you pay.

mainEntity.name: Is Prompt more expensive than other systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: In some cases, yes—but the ROI is clear. Clinics often see faster, compliant documentation, higher revenue, fewer cancellations, and better work-life balance within 30-60 days.

mainEntity.name: Does Prompt have built-in billing tools?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Prompt includes a natively built RCM platform with real-time claim tracking, payer rule alerts, and integrated 2-way clearinghouse connection—no add-ons required.

mainEntity.name: What kind of AI does Prompt use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prompt’s AI supports real-time documentation, CPT coding, and workflows. Unlike other platforms, it’s built for accuracy, efficiency, and compliance—not just automation for the sake of it.

mainEntity.name: Can I customize my templates and workflows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Completely. From evals and notes to automations and dashboards, Prompt gives you full control—without sacrificing compliance.

mainEntity.name: Is Prompt right for my size of clinic?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prompt is built to scale—from solo providers to multi-location practices. Whether you’re just starting out or growing fast, we’ll grow with you.
